sources.facts: createSourceFile supports AST traversal without a type checker; current wiki describes API through 6.x and warns that 7.1 API differs.
JSX/TypeScript syntax plugins, node ranges and error handling options are documented.
Parser API and source byte offsets are documented; language grammars/bindings require separate packaging.
TypeScript resolution substitutes extensions and depends on selected resolution modes; an exact .js manifest path alone does not prove TS binding.
